en:
Ahem! This is an announcement from the
Ultimate Academy.

The time is now 10:00 p.m.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Nighttime<CLT=cltNORMAL> has officially begun.

Killers, this is your chance to strike!
Victims, you have my condolences!

Will you sleep like a baby tonight?
Or sleep with the fishes?
<CLT=cltMIND>Who could it be at this hour?

Kaito asked me earlier...to show him my
research lab.

I might as well show him, since I know he
won't take no for an answer...

<CLT=cltMIND>How many more nights do I have to
sleep in this bed? I'm so...sick of it!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
killing game? What is their objective...?
